title: Agent users / day

args.command: call --json execute-sql {"query": "SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, uniq(person_id) AS users FROM events WHERE event LIKE 'agentic_%' AND timestamp >= today() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND timestamp < today() GROUP BY day ORDER BY day"}

jq: .results | split("\n")[1:] | map(split("|")) | {x: map(.[0]), series: [{name: "users", values: map(.[1] | tonumber)}]}
